errors.evidence: The description claims the vertical axis has a label "Дял в %" (Share in %), but the axis is not labeled in the figure.

The description states that in 2022, the share of Bulgaria in Ukrainian imports was 1.23%. However, the chart shows this value to be 3.72 (the red bar for 2022). The value 1.23 corresponds to the share in Ukrainian exports for 2021.

errors.text_span: Някои от стълбовете са визуално разграничени чрез цветовете си
errors.evidence: The phrase "Някои от стълбовете" (Some of the bars) is inaccurate and ambiguous. All bars are part of one of two color-coded categories (blue for export, red for import); it's not a feature of just "some" of them.
